title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 (Finale) "Mugendai MewType" Preview Released
content:
BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 preview has been released on Tuesday. The episode is set to premiere on September 10 at 11:00 PM JST and it is titled “Mugendai Mewtype.” The synopsis is as follows:

Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are. Remaining different, yet standing in the same place. From this stage, it’s going to get even more fun. That voice will spread everywhere.

Midori Goto ( BanG Dream! It’s MyGo!!!!! , Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast ) is writing the episode’s script with the direction of Kotaro Ogawa and the storyboard is done by Tomomi Umezu ( Blue Archive The Animation Episode 5). Kenta Sasaki is handling the storyboard of the episode’s live part.

NICHICALINE is animating with Tomomi Umezu as the director and Hiroshi Morita is the assistant director. Midori Goto is in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo are in charge of character design. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

BanG Dream! is a multimedia music franchise created by Bushiroad president Takaaki Kidani. The project launched in January 2015, and it originally began as a manga before expanding into various media formats. Since then, BanG Dream has grown to include additional manga series, TV anime series, live concerts, singles and albums, VTuber projects, and a mobile rhythm game BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 Main Visual Revealed
content:
MARRIAGETOXIN has revealed its main visual for Season 2, which is scheduled to begin streaming in January 2027 . A new visual reveal PV was also revealed, along with an interview with director Motonobu Hori about the upcoming season.

The Season 2 visual features the large bridge where Hikaru Gero saved Mei Kinosaki in the first episode. According to the announcement, the composition is intended to emphasize the chemistry between the two as a duo.

Hori confirmed that production on Season 2 is progressing smoothly and teased several developments coming for Gero and Kinosaki. Characters from the first season will return, while Gero will also encounter a new potential marriage partner.

“An appealing new marriage prospect appears for Gero, and of course there are scenes in which the relationship between Gero and Kinosaki deepens through various developments, so I hope people enjoy that side of it as well.”

Hori said the goal is to maintain the first season’s momentum despite the demanding production, describing his intention to make a season that carries viewers through from beginning to end with the same energy.

The director also reflected on the response to Season 1 at Anime Expo 2026. Hori attended the event alongside Haruki Ishiya, who voices Gero, and Shion Wakayama, who voices Kinosaki, and said the enthusiastic overseas audience surprised him.

“I had thought the content of the source material was very Japanese, so I honestly did not imagine that audiences overseas would take to it so warmly.”

Discussing his approach to the adaptation, Hori explained that one of MARRIAGETOXIN ‘s defining qualities is how quickly it shifts between comedy, action, emotional drama and darker material. Rather than treating each genre separately, the production uses elements like music to connect scenes and keep a consistent emotional flow. He also emphasized that the action was deliberately treated seriously, preserving the contrast between Joumyaku’s absurd comedy and Mizuki Yoda’s polished artwork.

You can watch the visual reveal PV below.

The first season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes, covering the Water Master , Sound Master , and the Beast Master arcs. Studio BONES Film is back handling the animation production, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime worldwide. Season 2 will premiere in January 2027.

The voice cast for the anime includes:

• Shion Wakayama as Mei Kinosaki

• Haruki Ishiya as Hikaru Gero

• Anna Nagase as Kyoko Himekawa

• Mariya Ise as Shizuku Ushio

• Asaki Yuikawa as Shiori Ureshino

• Soma Saito as Genya Naruko

• Hinano Shirahama as Kimie Arashiyama

• Simba Tsuchiya as Piichi Nakagawa

The anime is directed by Motonobu Hori, who is known for Carole & Tuesday and Metallic Rogue . Serving as Chief Animation Director and Character Designer isohei Tokuoka, who served as Chief Animation Director for SK8 the Infinity and as Character Designer and Chief Animation Director for The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity . Studio BONES Film is known for animating big hits, including My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON and Gachiakuta .

Official synopsis:

For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline – by force if necessary – Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride. “That’s the first time anyone’s ever proposed like that.” And so, with the cunning marriage swindler Mei as his advisor, elite assassin Hikaru embarks on the most challenging mission of his life: finding a wife! Their goal: the ultimate marriage. This is the world’s toughest mission for love, brought to you by the ultimate duo – an assassin and a marriage swindler! To win love, you’ve got to play with poison. A high-stakes mission for the ultimate duo begins!

MARRIAGETOXIN full anime staff:

• Director: Motonobu Hori

• Series Composition & Script: Kimiko Ueno

• Character Design & Chief Animation Director: Kohei Tokuoka

• Sub Character Design: Yurika Sako

• Costume Design: Kotono

• Prop Design: Ayumi Nagaki, Ryo Hirata

• Art Design: Toshiki Amata

• Art: Bihou

• Color Design: Hiroko Umezaki

• Photography Director: Go Kanbayashi

• 3DCG: SANZIGEN Inc.

• CG Animation Director: Taiki Nagashima

• Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

• Sound Effects: Tomokazu Mii

• Music: Taisei Iwasaki, yuma yamaguchi

• Production Supervision: Bones

• Animation Production: Bones Film

• Production: MARRIAGETOXIN Project

title: Dark Shonen Jump Anime Confirms Season 2 Return After 4 Years With First Look
content:
One of the darkest Shonen Jump anime series will be returning with a second season after almost four years. Over the decades, Shueisha’s Shonen Jump magazines have always been at the center of attention thanks to the exceptional stories they have to offer. Jump Square falls within the category as it includes monthly Shonen manga series across all genres, including action and horror. One such series is Dark Gathering , written and illustrated by Kenichi Kondo. The manga began serialization in 2019, and it’s nowhere near its finale yet. On the other hand, the anime premiered in July 2023 and released two cours until the end of the year.

Although a second season was confirmed last year, the official X handle of Pony Canon Anime shared its first look. The menacing visual features a mysterious entity at the end of a dark tunnel, which perfectly fits the tone of the story. Even among Shonen Jump series, Dark Gathering is known for its gritty details and gory visuals that aren’t suited for the faint of heart.

Does Dark Gathering Season 2 Have a Release Date?

The visual only reveals that the anime will be released in 2027, but hasn’t locked down an exact window yet. However, we might expect more updates by the end of the year or in the first half of 2027. The anime still hasn’t revealed a teaser, which might announce the release window and more details. The horror visual doesn’t include any other information except for the new release of Volume 20 of the manga. However, according to the official website of Crunchyroll , we can expect the main cast and crew to return in the second season.

Since the anime runs on a monthly schedule, it took four years to return so that the animation studio will have enough chapters for another season. We can expect the series to return to HIDIVE, where the first season premiered internationally in 2023. Additionally, the anime is now also available on Prime Video, but fans still can’t find it on Crunchyroll or Netflix.

What to Expect From Dark Gathering Season 2

Without an episode schedule, it’s impossible to determine how many chapters the second season will adapt. The first season released 25 episodes for the entire second half of 2023, but there’s always a chance the sequel will return with only one cour that spans 12 to 13 episodes. The story centers around Keitaro Gentoga wants to put his supernatural abilities behind him and live a normal life as a college student. However, his life turns upside down when he meets Yayoi, a girl with similar supernatural abilities.

It doesn’t take long for him to be dragged into her mission of capturing and enslaving violent spirits to prepare for battle against the spirit that stole the soul of Yayoi’s mother. The first season adapted 34 chapters from the manga, which means the sequel will adapt the intense Kyoto Arc , following Yayoi, Keitaro, and Eiko as they travel to Kyoto to confront dangerous new ghosts and mysterious state-made gods. We can also expect the anime to get even more terrifying with the introduction of more powerful monsters with unique abilities.

title: Crunchyroll’s Major Isekai Takes a New Turning Point in Latest Season
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the light novel! The exciting Fall 2026 is less than a month away, which means most of the major Summer anime series are heading towards their finale. This also includes Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation , which premiered its Season 3 in July this year. Among the endless stream of anime on Crunchyroll, Mushoku Tensei stands out for being just as popular as it is controversial. While many fans appreciate the world-building and the storytelling, others can’t deny the problematic tropes that are often criticized on social media. However, the controversies only contribute to the popularity of the anime.

Although the anime will keep covering Rudeus’ journey for at least a few more years, the light novel, written by Rifujin na Magonote and illustrated by Sirotaka, reached its conclusion in 2022. Season 3 is by far the most shocking and intense part of the story as things take a massive turn in the latest Episode 11. So far, the story has taken four major turning points, and each time, something unprecedented takes place that shocks fans. Not to mention that the latest turning point is somehow related to the mysterious Man-God, often known as Hitogami among fans.

Who Is Hitogami in Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation ?

The story has five total turning points, and the anime just adapted the fourth one, which is also somehow tied to the Man-God. While he doesn’t show up in every turning point, the events are driven by his actions. This time as well, he appears in Rudeus’ dream to offer him advice. The mysterious figure has a blank and featureless face with a noticeable grin. Because his face is blurry, it makes it impossible for Rudeus to remember his face.

Despite that, Rudeus still trusted the mysterious being in his dreams who offered a hand when he was vulnerable. In the latest Episode 11 of Season 3, after the conversation with Man-God, Rudeus encountered an old man who appears to be his older version from the future. The man warns Rudeus against trusting the Man-God, implying he knows more than he lets on. Considering how the future version of Rudeus was forced to turn back time, it’s clear that a major tragedy took place in the future.

The events in the future left the old Rudeus with so much regret that he had no choice but to turn back time and fix everything that happened. In fact, the tragedy is somehow tied to the Man-God, which is why the old Rudeus warned his younger self against the mysterious entity. Man-God serves as the final antagonist of the overarching plot, and his actions are far more twisted than one can realize.

title: Marriage Toxin TV Anime's 2nd Season Reveals Promo Video, Key Visual
content:
The staff of the second season of the television anime for Jōmyaku and artist Mizuki Yoda 's Marriage Toxin manga revealed a promotional video and a key visual for the season on Tuesday.

The second season will debut in 2027 and will feature a returning staff.

Motonobu Hori ( Carole & Tuesday ) is directing the anime at Bones Film with production supervision by BONES . Kimiko Ueno ( Astro Note ) is writing and overseeing the series scripts. Taisei Iwasaki ( BELLE ) and Yuma Yamaguchi ( Metallic Rouge ) are composing the music. Kōhei Tokuoka ( The Fragrant Flower Blooms With Dignity ) serves as chief animation director and character designer.

The first season of the anime debuted on April 7. The anime aired on Tuesdays on Kansai TV and Fuji TV 's new Tuesday night programming block, titled "Ka-Anival!!" Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it airs.

Shueisha describes the anime:

For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters' Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru's sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline – by force if necessary – Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride. “That's the first time anyone's ever proposed like that.” And so, with the cunning marriage swindler Mei as his advisor, elite assassin Hikaru embarks on the most challenging mission of his life: finding a wife! Their goal: the ultimate marriage. This is the world's toughest mission for love, brought to you by the ultimate duo – an assassin and a marriage swindler! To win love, you've got to play with poison. A high-stakes mission for the ultimate duo begins!

Actress and singer Yurina Hirate performed the first season's opening theme song "Kill or Kiss." Singer-songwriter AKASAKI performed the ending theme song "Shake Na Baby."

Jōmyaku and Yoda launched the manga on the Shonen Jump+ app in April 2022. Shueisha published the manga's 18th compiled book volume on July 3. Viz Media licensed the manga. The manga is also in English on Shueisha 's MANGA Plus app.

title: Shonen Jump’s Breakout Anime Hit Reveals First Look Trailer for Season 2 – Watch
content:
One of the biggest Shonen Jump anime breakout hits of the year is coming back for Season 2 in 2027, and the first trailer is helping to show off the first look at what’s coming next. Shonen Jump has seen a number of its major franchises making their official anime adaptation debuts this year, and one has been a breakout success pretty much right from the jump. The anime for Joumyaku and Mizuki Yoda’s Marriagetoxin made its debut earlier this Spring , and the studio behind My Hero Academia really went all out for it.

Marriagetoxin wrapped up its run earlier this Spring , and quickly confirmed that Season 2 of the anime was now in the works for a release next year. Now as we get closer to the end of 2026, Marriagetoxin Season 2 has dropped the best look at the next major season yet with a new trailer showing it all off in action. You can check it out below along with a brand new key visual showing a new look at its main duo too.

When Does Marriagetoxin Season 2 Come Out?

Marriagetoxin Season 2 is currently scheduled to release sometime in January 2027 as part of the Winter 2027 anime schedule, but a concrete release date has yet to be revealed as of this time. It’s also yet to confirm any international release plans as of this time, but you can catch up with everything that happened in the first season now streaming with Crunchyroll in the meantime. title: The Apothecary Diaries Confirms New Spinoff Release For U.S. Fans After Season 3
content:
The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 is all set to premiere next month as part of the Fall 2026 lineup. Based on the critically acclaimed light novel by Hyūganatsu, the story primarily follows Maomao, a genius apothecary with a knack for solving mysteries. With more than 57 million copies of the light novel and manga volumes in circulation, it’s easily one of the most popular franchises in the world. A lot of the credit for the series’ global popularity goes to the anime adaptation, which premiered in 2023 and keeps returning with new seasons. While the third season is closer to its release date than ever, the official website of Viz Media confirms a brand new manga release for fans in the U.S.

The light novel released two official manga adaptations, one of which has been recently licensed by Viz Media. The second volume of The Apothecary Diaries: Maomao’s Notes on the Inner Palace will be released on December 15th, 2026. The publisher previously announced that the first volume would be released on October 20th, 2026. Both volumes are available for pre-order, and the links have already been shared by Viz Media. We can also expect more volumes to be released next year, and they will be available in both physical and digital versions.

Does The Apothecary Diaries Have Two Manga Adaptations?

Although there is no official announcement regarding this, the light novel does have two manga adaptations from different artists . The reason behind it could be the overlapping, non-exclusive contracts originally signed by the original publisher. The manga illustrated by Nekokurage was released in May 2017, and it’s generally more popular among the fandom.

A few months later, in August 2017, another manga series illustrated by Minoji Kurata was released. Both manga adapt events from the original light novel, though they have distinct art styles, pacing, and tone to the story. The first manga series has already been serialized by Square Enix for quite a while, but it’s the first time Kurata’s version will be available for international fans. Since it’s a fairly new adaptation for fans in the West, Kurata’s manga is still quite underrated.

What to Expect From The Apothecary Diaries Season 3

This is the first time the anime will take a break between its cours. The first and second seasons released both their cours consecutively, but Season 3 will only release its first part in the Fall 2026 anime season. The second cour will be released in April next year as part of the Spring 2026 anime lineup. The anime is all set to return to Crunchyroll on October 2nd, 2026 to adapt the fifth volume of the light novel.

The story will continue after the fall of the Shi Clan, which changed Maomao and Jinshi’s lives forever. While Maomao returned to the Verdigris House as an apothecary, Jinshi abandoned his fake identity as a eunuch and officially began his royal duties. He will seek Maomao’s help in the upcoming season to ask her to help solve the mystery behind the strange incidents happening in the northern farming villages.

title: Firefly Wedding Anime Reveals Key Visual at Advance Screening Event
content:
Firefly Wedding TV anime revealed a new key visual during a screening event ahead of its October 9, 2026 premiere. The second promotional video was revealed in August.

The main voice cast for the anime includes:

• Lynn as Satoko Kirigaya

• Koki Uchiyama as Shinpei Goto

• Kento Ito as Kotaro Ogawa

• Kenjiro Tsuda as Mitsueda

The key visual was revealed during an advance screening event held at United Cinema Toyosu in Japan on September 6, where Episodes 1-3 were shown ahead of broadcast. Cast members Lynn, Koki Uchiyama and Kento Ito appeared on stage in kimono and spoke about the series, its characters and the anime adaptation’s appeal. You can see the new visual below.

Takahiro Kamei is directing the series at studio david production ( Fire Force ). Yuko Kakihara is handling series composition and scripts, with Yukiko Aikei as character designer. Music is composed by NOGRID. You can watch the latest trailer below.

Oreco Tachibana’s original manga is serialized through Shogakukan’s MangaONE app. The series has surpassed 4.5 million copies in circulation, with 12 collected volumes currently available. It previously also won the 2024 Digital Comic Award. The story follows Satoko, the daughter of a prestigious family who has been told she has little time left to live. Her goal is to marry into another prominent family and make her father proud, but her life changes after she gets kidnapped.

Facing a desperate situation alongside assassin Shinpei, Satoko lies and proposes marriage to him, promising that he can have everything if they become a couple. Unexpectedly, Shinpei takes the proposal seriously and becomes devoted to Satoko as she struggles between her responsibilities and her growing feelings for him.

title: Black Clover Season 2 Announces October 3 Premiere
content:
Black Clover Season 2 anime has officially announced that it will premiere on October 3, 2026. The anime previously revealed the main trailer and theme song by rock band WANIMA, as well as confirmed that Ayataka Tanemura will return to direct the anime’s second season. Crunchyroll will stream the anime, and it will host an early screening for North America this month.

The main staff for Season 2 includes:

• Director: Ayataka Tanemura

• Series Composition: Keiichiro Ochi

• Character Design: Itsuko Takeda

• Sub-Character Design: Kumiko Tokunaga

• Prop Design: Kosei Takahashi

• Music: Minako Seki

• Animation Production: Studio Pierrot

The opening song by WANIMA is titled “Kienai Riyuu” (The Reason That Won’t Disappear).

ALSO READ: Black Clover Creator Draws Toru Oikawa From Haikyu!! Black Clover Final Volume and Official Guidebook Released, Includes New 15-Page Manga by Yuki Tabata

The main visual was also recently revealed.

The Black Clover manga was serialized in the Weekly Shonen Jump magazine from 2015 to August 2023, before transferring to Jump GIGA . It entered its final arc in August 2022 and officially ended on May 1 after eleven years of serialization. The manga is available to read on Viz Media’s website, MANGA Plus website, and the Shonen Jump mobile app in English.

It received a 170-episode anime adaptation by Studio Pierrot, which ran from 2017 to 2021. The Black Clover: Sword of the Wizard King movie premiered on June 16 and is streaming on Netflix. Crunchyroll streams the TV anime, and they describe the story:

In a world where magic is everything, Asta and Yuno are both found abandoned at a church on the same day. While Yuno is gifted with exceptional magical powers, Asta is the only one in this world without any. At the age of fifteen, both receive grimoires, magic books that amplify their holder’s magic. Asta’s is a rare Grimoire of Anti-Magic that negates and repels his opponent’s spells. Being opposite but good rivals, Yuno and Asta are ready for the hardest of challenges to achieve their common dream: to be the Wizard King. Giving up is never an option!

title: The Power of Will: Rie Takahashi and Saori Hayami on Rediscovering 'Magic Knight Rayearth'
content:
Since its debut in 1993, CLAMP 's Magic Knight Rayearth has remained a beloved classic, remembered for its memorable heroines, imaginative fantasy world, and themes of friendship and willpower. Now, over thirty years later, the series returns with a brand-new television anime adaptation, introducing the magical world of Cefiro to a new generation when it premieres this October.

Ahead of the anime's advance screening at Anime Expo 2026, we sat down with Rie Takahashi and Saori Hayami , who voice Fuu Hououji and Princess Emeraude, respectively. Together, they reflected on inheriting these beloved characters, the enduring appeal of Magic Knight Rayearth, and the passion that has gone into reimagining one of shoujo manga's most iconic adventures for a new era.

── Magic Knight Rayearth is an adventure shoujo manga that began in 1993. When was your first introduction to the work?

Takahashi: My first encounter with the title was through the audition for this new anime. I was already familiar with the characters, but not the story itself. Since I was curious about the story, I felt like this was a wonderful opportunity.

Hayami: I must have watched the anime as a child, but I was so young at the time that I don't really remember it. However, I'm fairly sure I did watch it because some Rayearth pencils were still at my parents' house.

──The world of Cefiro is unique and creative in many ways. What was the most interesting or surprising thing you found about Cefiro?

Takahashi: First of all, the world itself amazed me—but explaining why would spoil too much. So if I had to choose something to say, it would be the flying fish soaring through the air.

Hayami: The scene where all sorts of creatures would suddenly appear really took me by surprise.

──What do you think is the appeal of your respective characters? Please tell us what you kept in mind when recording.

Takahashi: I think the charm of the character I play, Hououji Fuu-chan, is her ability to make decisions using her sharp insight no matter what situation she encounters. While recording, I was careful that her way of thinking about things didn't waver, that her logic remained consistent, even if that meant her presence felt different from Hikaru-chan and Umi-chan.

Hayami: One of Princess Emeraude's charms is the way she carries out her duty of praying for the sake of the world with a strong sense of responsibility. At the same time, I'm really drawn to the fact that she still has to deal with very human emotions inside of herself. I focused on how much of that complex inner world should be incorporated into the story, and adjusted it each episode while recording.

──Although Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu were unacquainted back in Tokyo, they quickly become very close in Cefiro. Takahashi-san, what are your impressions of Hikaru and Umi, and the three girls' friendship?

Takahashi: It made me realize that the strength of a friendship isn't measured by how long you've known someone. Even though they still have a lot to learn about each other, they've already built such a strong bond of trust, and I think that's really special.

──What was it like working with Hikaru and Umi's actresses?

Takahashi: The two actresses who played Hikaru and Umi have always loved Rayearth, so I felt like I could entrust my own acting to them, and performed in a way that wouldn't diverge from them. At first, the three of us were nervous about the characters we were playing, but as we continued acting, I think we developed a bond where we felt, "No one else could be our partner but you."

──Hayami-san, Princess Emeraude and Zagato both live in the world of Cefiro. We can't really talk too much about their relationship, but what was it like working with Zagato's actor, Ono Yuuki?

Hayami: Ono Yuuki-san is an actor I've known for a long time, but this time it felt a little new going back-and-forth as opposing counterparts. Ono-san was very motivated, approaching each episode's recording with great care, and seeing him like that also made me feel more determined and motivated.

──Power of will is a core theme of the story. What does this phrase mean to you?

Takahashi: I think it's very true. Since we receive voice acting work through auditions, I think it's kind of like the bigger your feelings of "I want to get it" or "I'm gonna get it" are, the higher your chances of success will become.

Hayami: I think that the power of will gives you confidence in yourself, which then drives you to take action. And it doesn't only motivate us personally, it's also a power that inspires those around us. For example, I strongly feel that Takahashi Rie-chan has an incredible power of will, and watching Rie-chan tackle things with such determination then fires us up, so we can tackle things together with her.

──The girls handle the prospect of being transported to another world with differing reactions. If you were suddenly transported from the Tokyo Tower, how do you think you'd react?

Takashi: For a moment, I'd want to find out if I could fly.

Hayami: I'd probably think, "Maybe I fell asleep with my VR goggles on?"

──Do you have any memorable moments you can share from the recording sessions with the other cast and staff?

Takahashi: During the voice recording for the first episode, feedback was given that "they're getting along too well, please make it feel a little more like they're meeting for the first time." There was a bit too much worry shown for the other person. So it was necessary to go back to a distance where the characters hadn't introduced themselves yet. To let the story unfold from there, that initial sense of distance was needed.

Hayami: What I remember most is how every time we had a voice recording session, the three main cast members would show up wearing clothes or accessories that matched their characters' colors. It made me feel warm and happy.

Takahashi: I ended up buying a lot of green clothes (laughs)

Hayami: I can see that.

──Are there any scenes that were impactful for you, or that you'd like fans to look forward to?

Takahashi: I love the scene where Fuu-chan comes face-to-face with herself. When I read it for the audition, I really came to like Fuu-chan's choice of words in that scene, so I was even more fired up during the actual performance.

Hayami: When it comes to Princess Emeraude, there's still so much that I can't say, but when she talks with Zagato, the atmosphere around these two has a uniqueness that's a bit unlike others, so I hope you'll pay close attention to these scenes.

Interview was conducted through an interpreter and has been edited for clarity.
